versions.changelog:
- Added a research-first workflow for creating Cliptude narration from a topic or title, including required web searches and verified research notes.
- Added script structure, duration-based word limits, narration style, accuracy rules, and text-to-speech spelling guidance.
- Clarified when to use a custom script, prompt, voiceover file, or talking-head video—and when to skip this skill.
- Added handoff guidance for generating a video and polling its job status.
